CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION ads.reverse_click_debit(p_reference_entry_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_created_by integer DEFAULT NULL::integer, p_reason text DEFAULT NULL::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(ledger_entry_id uuid, balance_after numeric, result_status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
DECLARE
    original ads.credit_ledger%ROWTYPE;
    existing_reversal ads.credit_ledger%ROWTYPE;
    existing_idempotency ads.credit_ledger%ROWTYPE;
    balance ads.account_balances%ROWTYPE;
    budget ads.campaign_budget_state%ROWTYPE;
    original_business_day date;
    current_business_day date := ads.business_date(clock_timestamp());
    v_reversal_amount numeric(14, 2);
    new_balance numeric(14, 2);
    new_ledger_id uuid;
    metrics_updated integer;
BEGIN
    IF nullif(trim(p_idempotency_key), '') IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'idempotency_key e obrigatoria';
    END IF;

    PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(
        hashtextextended(p_reference_entry_id::text, 91005)
    );

    SELECT ledger.*
      INTO original
      FROM ads.credit_ledger ledger
     WHERE ledger.ledger_entry_id = p_reference_entry_id;

    IF NOT FOUND
       OR original.entry_type <> 'DEBIT'
       OR original.source_type <> 'CLICK' THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Debito CPC original nao encontrado';
    END IF;

    SELECT ledger.*
      INTO existing_idempotency
      FROM ads.credit_ledger ledger
     WHERE ledger.idempotency_key = trim(p_idempotency_key);

    IF FOUND THEN
        IF existing_idempotency.reference_entry_id
           IS DISTINCT FROM p_reference_entry_id THEN
            RAISE EXCEPTION
                'idempotency_key ja usada para outro lancamento';
        END IF;

        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT existing_idempotency.ledger_entry_id,
               existing_idempotency.balance_after,
               'already_recorded'::text;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT ledger.*
      INTO existing_reversal
      FROM ads.credit_ledger ledger
     WHERE ledger.reference_entry_id = p_reference_entry_id
       AND ledger.entry_type = 'REVERSAL';

    IF FOUND THEN
        RETURN QUERY
        SELECT existing_reversal.ledger_entry_id,
               existing_reversal.balance_after,
               'already_reversed'::text;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    -- Ordem financeira: balance -> budget. O recibo original e imutavel.
    SELECT stored.*
      INTO balance
      FROM ads.account_balances stored
     WHERE stored.account_id = original.account_id
       AND stored.currency = original.currency
     FOR UPDATE;

    SELECT stored.*
      INTO budget
      FROM ads.campaign_budget_state stored
     WHERE stored.campaign_id = original.campaign_id
       AND stored.account_id = original.account_id
       AND stored.currency = original.currency
     FOR UPDATE;

    IF balance.account_id IS NULL OR budget.campaign_id IS NULL THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Saldo ou estado de orcamento ausente para estorno';
    END IF;

    IF budget.spent_date > current_business_day THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'spent_date futuro impede estorno';
    ELSIF budget.spent_date < current_business_day THEN
        UPDATE ads.campaign_budget_state target
           SET spent_today = 0,
               spent_date = current_business_day,
               version = target.version + 1,
               updated_at = clock_timestamp()
         WHERE target.campaign_id = budget.campaign_id
         RETURNING target.* INTO budget;
    END IF;

    v_reversal_amount := -original.amount;
    original_business_day := ads.business_date(original.occurred_at);

    IF budget.spent_total < v_reversal_amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estorno excede gasto total materializado';
    END IF;

    IF original_business_day = budget.spent_date
       AND budget.spent_today < v_reversal_amount THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Estorno excede gasto diario materializado';
    END IF;

    new_balance := balance.available_balance + v_reversal_amount;

    UPDATE ads.account_balances target
       SET available_balance = new_balance,
           version = target.version + 1,
           updated_at = clock_timestamp()
     WHERE target.account_id = balance.account_id;

    UPDATE ads.campaign_budget_state target
       SET spent_total = target.spent_total - v_reversal_amount,
           spent_today =
               CASE
                   WHEN original_business_day = target.spent_date
                   THEN target.spent_today - v_reversal_amount
                   ELSE target.spent_today
               END,
           version = target.version + 1,
           updated_at = clock_timestamp()
     WHERE target.campaign_id = budget.campaign_id;

    INSERT INTO ads.credit_ledger (
        account_id,
        campaign_id,
        delivery_id,
        event_id,
        advertisement_id,
        creative_id,
        placement_id,
        billing_model,
        ad_type,
        price_snapshot,
        entry_type,
        source_type,
        amount,
        currency,
        balance_after,
        idempotency_key,
        reference_entry_id,
        occurred_at,
        created_by,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        original.account_id,
        original.campaign_id,
        original.delivery_id,
        original.event_id,
        original.advertisement_id,
        original.creative_id,
        original.placement_id,
        original.billing_model,
        original.ad_type,
        original.price_snapshot,
        'REVERSAL',
        'REVERSAL',
        v_reversal_amount,
        original.currency,
        new_balance,
        trim(p_idempotency_key),
        original.ledger_entry_id,
        clock_timestamp(),
        p_created_by,
        jsonb_build_object('reason', p_reason)
    )
    RETURNING credit_ledger.ledger_entry_id INTO new_ledger_id;

    UPDATE ads.daily_metrics metrics
       SET reversal_count = metrics.reversal_count + 1,
           reversal_amount = metrics.reversal_amount + v_reversal_amount,
           cost = metrics.cost - v_reversal_amount,
           updated_at = clock_timestamp()
     WHERE metrics.metric_date = original_business_day
       AND metrics.account_id = original.account_id
       AND metrics.campaign_id = original.campaign_id
       AND metrics.advertisement_id = original.advertisement_id
       AND metrics.creative_id = original.creative_id
       AND metrics.placement_id = original.placement_id
       AND metrics.currency = original.currency
       AND metrics.cost >= v_reversal_amount;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS metrics_updated = ROW_COUNT;

    IF metrics_updated <> 1 THEN
        RAISE EXCEPTION
            'Metrica financeira original ausente ou insuficiente para estorno';
    END IF;

    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT new_ledger_id, new_balance, 'reversed'::text;
END;
$function$
functions.args: p_reference_entry_id uuid, p_idempotency_key text, p_created_by integer, p_reason text
functions.name: reverse_click_debit
